device: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU
measurement: Synthetic single-GPU TreeRL PPO status loop. The old path materializes three CUDA scalar metrics with .item() and copies/reduces/copies each of eight fields independently. The packed path inserts three detached CUDA scalars into one FP32 vector and copies its result to CPU once. World-size-one all_reduce is an identity, matching the Phase B shim; transformer work and multi-rank collective latency are excluded.
